clips.title: The story
paras: At Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn, hostile murlocs hold the southern shore and renegade wizards camp on the island. Heroes' Vigil honors those lost in the First War.

Families and pilgrims once crossed the calm waters to honor the dead at Heroes' Vigil. The stone memorial was raised on the lake's central island to mark the heavy loss of human life in the First War against the Orcish Horde. Now renegade wizards have made camp beside the monument, and the island has become a hostile place.

Aggressive murlocs have claimed the southern banks of Stone Cairn Lake. Their crude huts line the water, and they harass anyone who comes near. The hills and rocky outcrops around the lake hold rich mineral veins, drawing prospectors and miners despite the dangers along the shore.
